**Assignment and Role:**
As an actuarial assistant, I will evaluate the data preparation phase of a claim frequency prediction model to assess its quality and identify potential improvements.

**Evaluation Actions:**

* **Data quality checks:**
  • Verify data completeness and accuracy
  • Identify missing values and handling strategies
  • Validate data types and formats
* **Feature engineering:**
  • Assess feature relevance and importance
  • Identify correlations and multicollinearity
  • Consider feature scaling and normalization
* **Data normalization and transformation:**
  • Verify data distribution and skewness
  • Apply transformations (e.g., log, square root) if necessary
  • Check for outliers and their impact on the model
* **Data splitting and sampling:**
  • Verify train-test split ratio and randomness
  • Assess sampling bias and potential overfitting
* **Model assumptions and limitations:**
  • Validate assumptions of the model (e.g., normality, independence)
  • Identify potential biases and model limitations
